choices.why: A light cream three-seat sofa with tapered wood legs; it gives the Nordic, warm base in cream tones, and its 234 cm width suits the long left wall.
A comfortable cognac leather armchair for reading; it adds warmth and contrast against the cream sofa and goes with the oak floor.
A warm wood waterfall coffee table with a simple, Nordic line; at 100x55 cm it fits well between the sofa and the armchair.
At 292x231 cm, it is big enough to go under the sofa, the armchair and the coffee table, in soft wool tones from beige to grey that anchor the seating area.
A light wood table with a herringbone top, 180 cm long so six can sit comfortably by the window, in a light Nordic style.
Light beech chairs with natural cord seats, very Nordic, in the same tone as the table's light wood.
A cream linen drum pendant that gives warm, diffused light over the table and repeats the room's textiles.
A slim, adjustable black reading lamp, minimalist and functional next to the armchair.
A white sideboard with light wood herringbone fronts that echoes the dining table top and keeps the space bright.
White sheer panels on each side of the window that soften the light without blocking it.
Textured cushions in grey and cream that add texture without breaking the soft palette.
A chunky knit throw with fringe in a warm taupe that brings cozy texture to the cream sofa.
A pair of copper-toned forest prints with a natural theme that pick up the warm woods above the sofa.
An embossed ceramic vase in a soft green, the touch of green you asked for, on the table or the sideboard.

answer.why: Light woods, cream and beige textiles, and accents of cognac and sage green build a warm Nordic living-dining room on the oak floor. The cream living area is anchored by the large rug in the middle of the room, and the light dining set sits by the window.
